messages.text: Mpango otomatiki kulingana na makadirio yako

messages.sourceEnglish: Match your saved buyer targets to whole beds or field plots using your own growing estimates. This does not choose a local crop calendar or promise weekly deliveries.
messages.text: Linganisha malengo yako ya wanunuzi yaliyohifadhiwa na vitanda vizima au mashamba ya wazi ukitumia makadirio yako mwenyewe ya kilimo. Hii haichagui kalenda ya mazao ya eneo husika wala haiahidi uwasilishaji wa kila wiki.
Kagua mchoro uliohifadhiwa

messages.sourceEnglish: No current design has been checked for this review.
messages.text: Hakuna mchoro wa sasa uliokaguliwa kwa ajili ya ukaguzi huu.
Malengo ya wanunuzi na kipaumbele

messages.sourceEnglish: Save buyer targets and growing estimates above first. Select each target and its matching estimate profile. Earlier targets have priority.
messages.text: Hifadhi kwanza malengo ya wanunuzi na makadirio ya kilimo hapo juu. Chagua kila lengo na wasifu wake wa makadirio unaolingana. Malengo ya mapema yana kipaumbele.
Chagua makadirio yako yaliyohifadhiwa
Tarehe ya kwanza ya kupanga (UTC)
Upangaji unaisha kabla ya (UTC)
Nafasi yako ya kilimo inayopatikana

messages.sourceEnglish: Nothing is assumed free. Enter each available interval. Known existing occupations are checked separately and cannot be overridden here. End dates are exclusive.
messages.text: Hakuna kinachochukuliwa kuwa wazi. Weka kila kipindi kinachopatikana. Shughuli zilizopo zinazojulikana hukaguliwa kando na haziwezi kubatilishwa hapa. Tarehe za mwisho zimetengwa.

messages.sourceEnglish: No eligible saved bed or field-plot measurements have been checked.
messages.text: Hakuna vipimo vya vitanda au mashamba ya wazi vilivyohifadhiwa vinavyostahiki vilivyokaguliwa.
Inapatikana kuanzia
Inapatikana hadi (haikujumuishwa)

messages.sourceEnglish: I supply these planning dates and availability as my estimates.
messages.text: Ninatoa tarehe hizi za kupanga na upatikanaji kama makadirio yangu.
Kagua mpango otomatiki wa mazao
Mizunguko ya mazao ya vitanda vizima inayopendekezwa
Kagua taarifa zilizowekwa kabla ya kupanga

messages.sourceEnglish: These are proposed estimates, not planted crops, observed stock or local farming approval. No crop cycle has been added to your saved plan.
messages.text: Haya ni makadirio yanayopendekezwa, si mazao yaliyopandwa, akiba iliyoonekana wala idhini ya kilimo cha eneo husika. Hakuna mzunguko wa zao ulioongezwa kwenye mpango wako uliohifadhiwa.

messages.sourceEnglish: I have reviewed the saved nursery equipment, recipes and loss estimates.
messages.text: Nimekagua vifaa vya kitalu, maelekezo ya ukuzaji na makadirio ya hasara yaliyohifadhiwa.

messages.sourceEnglish: No saved nursery containers or surfaces for this source.
messages.text: Hakuna vyombo au sehemu za kitalu zilizohifadhiwa kwa chanzo hiki.
Rasilimali za kitalu zinazopatikana

messages.sourceEnglish: I confirm these dated resource allocations.
messages.text: Ninathibitisha ugawaji huu wa rasilimali wenye tarehe.
Matumizi mengine ya kitalu
Ongeza matumizi shindani ya kitalu

messages.sourceEnglish: I have listed all other nursery uses, including none if this list is empty.
messages.text: Nimeorodhesha matumizi mengine yote ya kitalu, ikiwa ni pamoja na hakuna iwapo orodha hii ni tupu.

messages.sourceEnglish: I accounted for nursery resources used by these existing field occupations.
messages.text: Nilizingatia rasilimali za kitalu zilizotumiwa na shughuli hizi zilizopo za shambani.
Kagua mahitaji yako mwenyewe ya kitalu
Makadirio ya kitalu yenye tarehe
Makadirio ya kitalu yasiyokamilika

messages.sourceEnglish: This comparison covers containers and surface only. Seed purchasing quantities and seedling readiness can still be unknown.
messages.text: Ulinganisho huu unahusu vyombo na sehemu ya ardhi tu. Idadi ya mbegu za kununua na utayari wa miche bado unaweza kuwa haujulikani.
Pakua CSV ya kitalu iliyokaguliwa
